prompt:
One continuous locked-off wide shot of this exact illustrated Old Church Quarter street. Animate the existing residents in place while preserving the reference composition, architecture, perspective, sunlight, palette, faces, costumes and mature graphic-novel ink-and-painted rendering. Absolutely fixed tripod camera: no pan, zoom, push, drift, reframing or cuts. The foreground narrator will be composited separately: do not add a singer or any new person.
Clearly readable, lively characterful everyday actions with a relaxed shared musical pulse, alternating a gentle downward settle and lighter upward recovery, staggered naturally rather than synchronized dancing. The balcony gardener performs a clearly visible sequence: she leans forward and tips her watering can generously over the first pot, lifts the can, shifts her shoulders and stance toward the adjacent pot and waters it, then straightens up with a satisfied look and adjusts a leaf with her free hand. Her arms, torso and head move naturally through the whole sequence; keep her safely behind the balcony railing. At the table the older woman deliberately moves a chess piece and leans back to study the board while the man leans forward, reacts with an expressive hand gesture and nods; both remain seated. The tall seated reader turns one page, lowers his book a little to glance toward the street, then returns to reading, keeping his book coherent. The older woman on the RIGHT carrying the birdcage walks steadily toward SCREEN RIGHT from the very first frame. She takes continuous purposeful natural steps along the same pavement, passing completely beyond the RIGHT edge by 5 seconds. Her whole body, feet and the cage must leave the frame. She remains offscreen for the rest of the shot; no stopping, posing, turning back, walking in place or re-entering. The camera does not follow her. Keep the other residents in their original locations. Make the gestures visibly readable at this wide scale, with relaxed full-body weight shifts, still secondary to an unseen foreground singer. A light breeze stirs hanging laundry and foliage. Keep walls, windows, stairs, rails, chairs, table, bicycle and chessboard rigid and stable. Preserve clear inked silhouettes, crosshatching and layered depth, with distant features quieter. No photographic conversion, plastic 3D, children's cartoon simplification, face changes, extra limbs, new props, text or scene transitions. No generated music, dialogue or singing.
rhythmPolicy: Prompt requests rhythmic feel only; no claim of beat synchronization. Preserve accepted timing and continuous narrator performance.
characterReferences: Use existing scene identities at wide scale; no additional character sheets required for first trial.
revision: More active gardener and residents; cage carrier exits fully right by 5 seconds. Watermark-free export required.
